Covenant House

Global
Checked 2026-08-14

Covenant House provides safe harbor and supportive services to young people ages 18 to 24 who are facing homelessness, disconnection, and exploitation. The network offers emergency overnight shelters, meals, showers, and individualized case plans to help youth achieve stability.

  • Shelter
  • Food
  • Hygiene
  • Clothing
CostFree.

All services and programs are available at no cost.

AccessWalk-in 24/7 shelter
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide network covering the United States and Canada

Check before you go. Shelters are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. No referral is needed. Services are for young people ages 18 to 24 facing homelessness, disconnection, and exploitation.

Dress for Success

Global
Checked 2026-08-14

Dress for Success is a global network that empowers women to achieve economic mobility. It provides professional attire, a network of support, and career development tools to women seeking employment.

International Emergency Services

Global
Checked 2026-08-14

The Salvation Army's International Emergency Services (IES) provides critical relief, including food, water, and emergency shelter, to communities affected by disasters and conflict worldwide. The program supports local territories in disaster preparedness and response to meet immediate needs and build resilience.

  • Food
  • Shelter
  • Water
CostFree.

The services are provided at no cost to individuals affected by disasters and conflict.
